deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the stained slice through a tumour 'illustrates this' (referring to the explanting of tumours described in the preceding sentence). The lecturer only states that the image shows a slice through a tumour and a stain to look at morphology, without linking it as an illustration of tumour explantation.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like, biologists are studying tumors, often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is an informal remark about lecture management and personal timing, which is an allowed omission.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The word 'really' serves as an informal colloquial intensifier rather than a scientific hedge, so phrasing this as 'Primary cells do not grow in culture' is an allowed stylistic change.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Rendering 'and other things' as 'and other components' is an allowed stylistic improvement with the same meaning.
